sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A STRONG UPPER TROUGH WILL TRANSLATE EAST ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES THIS PERIOD WITH SUBSTANTIAL 12H 500MB HEIGHT FALLS OF 90-120M SPREADING SOUTH AND EAST FROM MT...ACROSS THE NRN GREAT BASIN...AND INTO THE NRN PLAINS BY EARLY WEDNESDAY. AN ELONGATED AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE EVOLVING FROM THE LEE-TROUGH OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS WILL DEEPEN IN RESPONSE TO THE ADVANCING UPPER TROUGH AND THEN TRACK EAST ACROSS THE DAKOTAS THROUGH LATE TODAY BEFORE CONSOLIDATING AND MOVING INTO SRN CANADA. THE COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS CYCLONE WILL LIKELY SURGE SEWD ACROSS ERN MT LATER TODAY BEFORE CONTINUING SEWD ACROSS MOST OF THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT. A BROAD UPPER RIDGE WILL PERSIST FROM THE SRN PLAINS NEWD TO THE MIDWEST WITH A WEAK PERTURBATION OR TWO EMBEDDED WITHIN THE LARGER RIDGE AXIS. DOWNSTREAM FROM THE UPPER RIDGE RIDGE...AN EQUALLY BROAD UPPER TROUGH AXIS IS FORECAST TO MAKE ONLY A SLOW EWD ADVANCE FROM THE TN VALLEY TO THE CAROLINAS THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG DYNAMICS ASSOCIATED WITH DEVELOPING SURFACE LOW PRESSURE AND LIFT ALONG TRIALING LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE AND ADVANCING COLD FRONT WILL ACT ON AN INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND PROMOTE SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE PARTS OF THE NRN PLAINS LATER TODAY BEFORE STORMS MOVE INTO NWRN MN OVERNIGHT. PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR SUPPORTING A MORE SUBSTANTIAL/WIDESPREAD SEVERE WEATHER EVENT ACROSS THESE AREAS WILL BE THE LACK OF GREATER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AVAILABLE TO THE DEVELOPING CYCLONE AND THE STRENGTH OF THE CAPPING INVERSION THAT SHOULD ACT TO SUPPRESS SURFACE-BASED STORM INITIATION UNTIL STRONGER FORCING ARRIVES WITH THE COLD FRONT AND HEIGHT FALLS LATE IN THE DAY. RELATIVELY HIGH CONFIDENCE EXISTS THAT A NARROW CORRIDOR OF GREATER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE WILL BE TRANSPORTED NWD ACROSS THE PLAINS AND INTO SD AND SRN ND. THIS PROCESS WILL BE AIDED BY THE STRONG CAPPING EVIDENT ON FORECAST SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE REGION AND EVAPOTRANSPIRATION. BY LATE AFTERNOON EXPECT THAT DEWPOINTS OF 55-60F MAY EXIST ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM PIR NORTH TO NEAR AND SOUTH OF BIS. STRONG HEATING IN THIS CORRIDOR WILL ALSO CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE VALUES CLIMBING TO AROUND 2000 J PER KG PRIOR TO OR SUBSEQUENT WITH

sections.title: SOUTHEAST
sections.text: PERSISTENT UPPER LOW WILL PROVIDE BACKGROUND ASCENT ADEQUATE FOR WIDESPREAD STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS MUCH OF THE SOUTHEAST TODAY. WINDS WITHIN THIS SYSTEM ARE CHARACTERIZED BY A BAND CYCLONIC FLOW ON THE ORDER OF 25-30KT IN THE MID LEVELS. STORM ACTIVITY SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AS GREATER DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION OCCURS AND RESULTS IN NUMEROUS CLUSTERS OF OCCASIONALLY BETTER ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS CAPABLE OF HAILSTONES PERHAPS NEARING AN INCH IN DIAMETER AS WELL AS SPORADIC CELL CAPABLE OF STRONGER WIND GUSTS. SINCE THIS REGIME APPEARS SIMILAR TO THE EVENTS OF MONDAY ACROSS MS WHERE NUMEROUS SEVERE HAIL/WIND EVENTS WERE REPORTED...ONLY DISPLACED SOMEWHAT EAST...A SMALL SLGT RISK AREA HAS BEEN INCLUDED IN THIS OTLK.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SRN PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED HIGH-BASED SUPERCELL STORMS MAY AGAIN INITIATE ALONG LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE FROM WRN NEB SOUTH TO TX. GREATER COVERAGE SHOULD BE LIMITED BY LACK OF STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT ACROSS THESE AREAS. HOWEVER...STEEP LOW AND MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO A COUPLE OF REPORTS OF WIND AND HAIL RESPECTIVELY. ..CARBIN/ROGERS.. 05/22/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IN THE MID/UPPER LEVELS...A STRONG TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE PACIFIC NW...NRN ROCKIES...AND OVER THE NRN PLAINS. AS 500-MB HEIGHT FALLS IN EXCESS OF 90 M OVERSPREAD THE NRN PLAINS...SFC LOW PRESSURE OVER SERN MT WILL INTENSIFY WHILE DEVELOPING ENEWD ALONG A WARM FRONT GRADUALLY ADVANCING NWD OVER ND/MN. A COLD FRONT TRAILING SWWD FROM THE LOW WILL SURGE SEWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT...WHILE MODEST MOISTURE RETURN LIES EAST OF A N-S-ORIENTED LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE THAT WILL BECOME OVERTAKEN BY THE SURGING FRONT. BETWEEN THE STRONG TROUGH AND A BROAD AREA OF PERSISTENT MID/UPPER-LEVEL CYCLONIC FLOW OVER THE SERN STATES...A WEAK RIDGE WILL EXTEND FROM PARTS OF THE MID MS VALLEY SWWD INTO THE SRN PLAINS. ...NRN PLAINS AND PARTS OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT... MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WILL DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR LEADING THE COLD FRONT/LEE TROUGH...AS A FAIRLY STRONG EML OVERLAYS MODEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE -- I.E. SFC DEWPOINTS MAINLY IN THE 50S. SCATTERED TSTMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACROSS THE CNTRL DAKOTAS INTO NWRN NEB INVOF THE SFC LOW AND COLD FRONT...AS LARGE-SCALE ASCENT

sections.title: SOUTHEAST THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING
sections.text: A POCKET OF RELATIVELY COOL MID-LEVEL TEMPERATURES ACCOMPANYING THE BROAD AREA OF CYCLONIC FLOW WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF 1000-2000 J/KG OF MLCAPE THIS AFTERNOON. SCATTERED STORMS WILL DEVELOP ALONG A NE-SW-ORIENTED SFC FRONT DRAPED ACROSS THE AREA AND INVOF REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES/HIGHER TERRAIN TO THE EAST OF THE FRONT. WITH 15-30 KT OF MID-LEVEL FLOW OVER THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THE CYCLONIC FLOW AREA...DEEP SHEAR SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR MULTICELL STORMS WITH DMGG WIND GUSTS AND SVR HAIL.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING
sections.text: ISOLATED HIGH-BASED SUPERCELL STORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP NEAR THE LEE TROUGH/DRYLINE FROM WRN NEB SOUTH TO TX. PRIMARILY NEUTRAL MID-LEVEL HEIGHT TENDENCIES WILL BE ASSOCIATED WITH LIMITED CONVECTIVE COVERAGE. HOWEVER...STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODEST DEEP SHEAR SHOULD YIELD AN ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT. ..COHEN/CORFIDI.. 05/22/2012

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE SERN STATES...

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: BROAD UPPER TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NW WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES DURING THE PERIOD AS A BAND OF STRONG MID/UPPER WINDS TRANSLATES ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES INTO THE PLAINS. SURFACE LOW OVER SERN MT IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO SWRN ND BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND CONTINUE NEWD TOWARD EXTREME SERN MANITOBA LATE TONIGHT. AS THE LOW MOVES INTO THE WRN DAKS BY EVENING...A COLD FRONT WILL PROGRESS EWD BEFORE REACHING THE ERN DAKS BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EWD FROM THE LOW ACROSS ND WILL LIFT SLOWLY NWD. DYNAMIC FORCING FOR LARGE SCALE ASCENT WILL INCREASE OVER THE NRN PLAINS AND ND IN PARTICULAR WITHIN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF THE UPPER JET AS IT MOVES TOWARD THE REGION TONIGHT. THIS WILL RESULT IN A FAVORABLE SYNOPTIC/MESOSCALE PATTERN FOR SEVERE STORMS...WITH THE PRIMARY LIMITING PARAMETER BEING MARGINAL LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AS RETURN FLOW FROM THE GULF OF MEXICO CONTINUES TO BE INHIBITED. 12Z RAOBS OVER THE CENTRAL/NRN PLAINS SUGGEST THAT MOISTURE ABOVE THE GROUND WILL MIX DOWNWARD WITHIN THE PBL AS HEATING OCCURS...WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS REACHING THE LOW/MID 50S. STRONG DIABATIC HEATING /ESPECIALLY OVER THE CENTRAL AND ERN DAKS/ WILL RESULT IN CONSIDERABLE IN

sections.text: COLD UPPER TROUGH WITH 500 MB TEMPERATURES NEAR -15C IS PROGRESSING EWD ACROSS AL ATTM. VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES NUMEROUS AREAS WITH LIMITED CLOUD COVER WHERE STRONG DIABATIC HEATING/DESTABILIZATION IS OCCURRING...AND MUCAPE IS EXPECTED TO REACH 1500-2000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ESPECIALLY OVER PARTS OF GA...SC...AND POSSIBLY NRN FL IN ADVANCE OF THE UPPER TROUGH...WITH STRONGER CELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ......CNTRL AND SRN PLAINS... HOWEVER...STEEP LOW/MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MODEST DEEP SHEAR SHOULD YIELD AN ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT. ..WEISS/GARNER.. 05/22/2012

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: PREVIOUS FORECAST REASONING LARGELY ON TRACK WITH ONLY MINOR MODIFICATIONS TO SPATIALLY ADJUST PROBABILITIES BASED ON RECENT OBSERVATIONAL DATA. SETUP STILL APPEARS LIKELY TO YIELD A FEW SUPERCELLS NEAR THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...DEVELOPING SWD ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN THE CNTRL DAKOTAS BY EARLY EVENING AS MLCIN DIMINISHES. ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELL/BOWING STRUCTURES MAY EVOLVE EWD DURING THE EVENING /PRIMARILY OVER ERN ND/. SEE MCD 0868 FOR NEAR-TERM FORECAST DISCUSSION IN SD/NEB.

sections.title: SERN STATES
sections.text: RELATIVELY GREATEST SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD EXIST NEXT FEW HOURS IMMEDIATELY S/E OF THE UPPER-LEVEL IMPULSE CENTERED OVER SERN AL/SWRN GA. ALTHOUGH DEEPER MIXING HAS RESULTED IN POCKETS OF SURFACE DEW POINTS FALLING THROUGH THE 50S...MID 80S TO LOWER 90S SURFACE TEMPERATURES ALONG WITH A MID-LEVEL COLD POCKET/ENHANCED WLYS WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND SEVERE HAIL. FARTHER N...WILL MAINTAIN A MARGINAL HAIL/WIND RISK GIVEN WEAKER DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND ABUNDANT OVERTURNING ALREADY.

sections.title: CNTRL AND SRN PLAINS
sections.text: SEE MCD 0867 FOR NEAR-TERM FORECAST DISCUSSION INVOF THE RATON MESA. THIS APPEARS TO BE THE MOST LIKELY ZONE FOR SUSTAINED TSTM DEVELOPMENT INTO EARLY EVENING...WHICH IS LARGELY SUPPORTED BY CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE. EFFECTIVE SHEAR SHOULD BE MARGINAL FOR HIGH-BASED SUPERCELLS OWING TO THE PRESENCE OF VEERED SURFACE/LOW-LEVEL FLOW OVER THE HIGH PLAINS. STILL...THE STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT MAY YIELD A FEW OCCURRENCES OF SEVERE WIND/HAIL. ..GRAMS/BUNTING.. 05/22/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT TUE MAY 22 2012/

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: ...NORTHERN PLAINS... THE LEAD PORTION OF A NORTHERN CONUS/CANADIAN ROCKIES UPPER TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED UPPER JET EXIT REGION WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EAST-NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH EARLY WEDNESDAY...WITH SEVERE TSTMS REMAINING POSSIBLE TONIGHT WITHIN A RELATIVELY MODEST MOISTURE QUALITY ENVIRONMENT ACROSS THE DAKOTAS/WESTERN MN. AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT WILL MAINLY CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS ND TO THE NORTH OF A SURFACE LOW/NEAR A WARM FRONT...ALTHOUGH AFOREMENTIONED MARGINAL MOISTURE AND THICK CLOUD COVER WILL BE LIMITING FACTORS FOR TORNADOES AS A SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET OTHERWISE STRENGTHENS TONIGHT. OTHERWISE...SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN A DISTINCT POSSIBILITY ACROSS THE CENTRAL/EASTERN DAKOTAS ESPECIALLY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH A NOCTURNAL EXPANSION OF TSTMS AND SUBSEQUENT UPSCALE GROWTH/TRANSITION TO MORE OF A WIND DAMAGE THREAT STILL REMAINING POSSIBLE.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: SEVERE HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE THIS EVENING...BUT ON AN INCREASINGLY ISOLATED/MARGINAL BASIS OWING TO A COOLING/CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED BOUNDARY LAYER. ..GUYER.. 05/23/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS AND/OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS S THROUGH EAST CENTRAL FL. IN ADDITION...PW VALUES AROUND 1.8 INCH AND HIGHER FREEZING LEVELS RESULTING IN WARM CLOUD PROCESSES WILL SUPPORT HEAVY RAINFALL RATES UP TO 1.5-2 INCH PER HOUR...ESPECIALLY WITH SUSTAINED ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1645Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED SHOWERS AND A FEW TSTMS HAVE ALREADY DEVELOPED ACROSS S FL...PRIMARILY INVOF TWO E-W ZONES OF LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE...AND THE INTERSECTIONS OF THESE BOUNDARIES WITH SEA/LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARIES PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY. SURFACE ANALYSES INDICATED ONE OF THE E-W BOUNDARIES WAS LOCATED S OF LAKE OKEECHOBEE FROM SRN PALM BEACH COUNTY THROUGH CENTRAL COLLIER COUNTY...WHILE THE SECOND ONE WAS OVER FAR S FL. DESPITE WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES PER THE 12Z MIA SOUNDING...SURFACE HEATING WITHIN A MOIST ENVIRONMENT WILL MAINTAIN MODERATE INSTABILITY. HOWEVER...THESE WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGEST VERTICAL PARCEL ACCELERATIONS WILL TEND TO BE WEAKER AND THUS LIMIT UPDRAFT STRENGTH/DURATION. MIA WSR-88D VWP DATA SHOWED WEAK VERTICALLY VEERING WINDS IN THE LOWEST 2-3 KM AGL...BUT STRONGER SWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ATOP SELY LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL SUPPORT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25-35 KT THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. THIS WILL AID IN SOME ORGANIZATION WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED STRONGER WIND GUSTS AS THE PRIMARY THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE DEVELOPING OVER THE ERN HALF OF GA THIS AFTERNOON AS THE AIR MASS UNDERGOES FURTHER DESTABILIZATION. WW ISSUANCE IS UNCERTAIN AT THIS TIME...GIVEN THE LACK OF STRONGER DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR STORM ORGANIZATION...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED THAT COULD RESULT IN WW ISSUANCE BEING GREATER THAN 40 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON INDICATED CU/TCU INCREASING IN AREAL COVERAGE FROM EAST CENTRAL THROUGH NERN GA INTO UPSTATE SC. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWED MUCAPE CURRENTLY RANGING FROM 1000 TO 2000 J/KG...WITH ADDITIONAL DIABATIC HEATING AIDING IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION AND STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES. DESPITE WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ATTM...THE AFOREMENTIONED THERMODYNAMICS COMBINED WITH FORCING FOR ASCENT/ MIDLEVEL COLD ADVECTION ATTENDANT TO THE EWD MOVING MID-UPPER LOW...NOW ADVANCING INTO WRN/CENTRAL GA PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY... SUGGEST UPDRAFTS SHOULD BECOME DEEPER/CONDUCIVE FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN THE TRACK OF THE MID-UPPER LOW...THE STRONGER FLOW ALOFT SHOULD BE FOCUSED ACROSS SRN GA/NRN FL INTO ERN SC WITH THESE AREAS HAVING THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR STORM ORGANIZATION AND THE NEED FOR A WW. UNIDIRECTIONAL WSWLY WIND FIELDS WITH BULK SHEAR OF 20-30 KT SUGGEST MULTICELLS AND LINE SEGMENTS SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY STORM MODES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON ACROSS NERN SC THROUGH CENTRAL AND ERN NC INTO SERN VA. WEAK WINDS/DEEP SHEAR ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT OVERALL STORM ORGANIZATION...THOUGH PW VALUES 1.3-1.5 INCH WILL PROMOTE HEAVY RAINFALL RATES WITH SOME POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS ATTENDANT TO PULSE-TYPE ACTIVITY. A FEW STRONGER CORES MAY SUPPORT AN ADDITIONAL THREAT FOR HAIL APPROACHING 1 INCH IN DIAMETER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY/LIGHTNING DATA INDICATED ONGOING WIDESPREAD TSTMS FROM NERN SC THROUGH CENTRAL/ERN NC INTO SERN VA. A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE STORMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. GREATEST CONCENTRATION OF ACTIVITY SHOULD PERSIST WITHIN A ZONE OF WEAK LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE EXTENDING SWWD FROM SERN VA THROUGH ERN NC. INTERMITTENT STRONGER CORES HAVE OCCURRED OVER NERN SC INTO SERN NC ATTENDANT TO UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION ALONG THE TRACK OF AN UPPER VORT...PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...TRACKING NNEWD ALONG THE SRN NC COAST. THE FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH THIS FEATURE SHOULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS...BUT WEAK DEEP LAYER WIND FIELDS SUGGEST STORM ORGANIZATION SHOULD BE LIMITED...RESULTING IN A LOW PROBABILITY FOR WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE OVER SERN CO...NERN NM AND THE WRN TX/OK PANHANDLES DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. THIS ACTIVITY IS THEN FORECAST TO SPREAD E-SEWD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE OK PANHANDLE...NRN TX PANHANDLE...AND PORTIONS OF SWRN KS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SURFACE HEATING IS OCCURRING OVER NERN NM INTO SERN CO...WITH TEMPERATURES AT 19Z NEAR 90F. THIS IS AIDING IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER AND SUBSEQUENT DEEPENING OF HIGH BASED CUMULUS. AS THE HIGH BASED CU ENCOUNTERS SLIGHTLY GREATER MOISTURE /LOW TO MID 50S DEWPOINTS/ OVER THE TX/OK PANHANDLES AND SWRN KS...SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED...AS DEPICTED IN 16Z HRRR. RAP FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STORMS WILL OCCUR IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP LOW AND MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-2000 J/KG...AND STRONGLY VEERING DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES. THIS MAY FAVOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ACROSS THE AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS LIKELY DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER FAR N-CNTRL NEB AND CNTRL SD. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MESOANALYSIS AT 19Z SHOWED A ZONE OF STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE ARCING S-SWWD FROM N-CNTRL SD INTO NWRN NEB. STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND VERY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE SPREADING NEWD OUT OF THE NEB PANHANDLE AND INTO PORTIONS OF CNTRL SD...WHICH IS AIDING IN THE REDUCTION OF CINH. IN ADDITION...50S TO NEAR 60 DEWPOINTS RESIDE ALONG/AHEAD OF THE SURFACE CONVERGENCE ZONE. THIS MOISTURE COMBINED WITH BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG BASED ON OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE. RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS A FEW ELEMENTS OF CUMULUS OCCURRING NEWD OUT OF WRN NEB AND INTO S-CNTRL SD. GIVEN THIS TREND...COMBINED WITH 17Z HRRR GUIDANCE...ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS PROBABLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. THE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT COLLOCATED WITH LOW-LEVEL SLYS VEERING TO 20-40 KT WLY MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS/LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS A SUPERCELL. THESE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED OVER PORTIONS OF WRN AND CNTRL ND BY EARLY EVENING...WITH ACTIVITY SPREADING EWD AND INCREASING IN COVERAGE DURING THE NIGHT. LARGE/VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY SVR WEATHER THREATS...BUT A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE AS WELL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 20Z...SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE CONSOLIDATING OVER WRN ND...WITH A COLD FRONT ARCING S-SWWD INTO WRN SD...AND A WARM FRONT EXTENDING EWD INTO ERN ND. S OF THE WARM FRONT...TEMPERATURES ARE WARMING TO NEAR 80F...WHILE DEWPOINTS HAVE INCREASED TO NEAR 60F. PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ALSO RESIDES ACROSS THE REGION...WHICH IS AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000-2000 J/KG. LATEST WV IMAGERY SHOWS A LEAD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE ASSOCIATED WITH EXIT REGION OF 100+ KT UPR JET EJECTING EWD ACROSS ERN MT...WITH A PLUME OF ASCENT SPREADING INTO THE NRN PLAINS. THE UPR SUPPORT COMBINED WITH STRONG LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INVOF THE SURFACE LOW WILL FAVOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT BY EARLY EVENING...WITH ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT LIKELY TO THE S ALONG THE COLD FRONT SOON AFTER. THE BIS VWP SHOWS SURFACE WINDS OUT OF THE SE INCREASING IN SPEED AND VEERING TO SLY AT 1 KM AGL...WITH FURTHER STRENGTHENING AND VEERING TO SWLY IN THE MIDLEVELS. THIS WIND PROFILE IS YIELDING STRONG LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH CURVATURE AND FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE/VERY LARGE HAIL. BY NIGHT...SVR THREAT MAY TRANSITION TO DAMAGING WINDS AS STRENGTHENING ASCENT FAVORS UPSCALE GROWTH. IN ADDITION...LOW-LEVEL SHEAR MAXIMIZED ALONG THE WARM FRONT...AS WELL AS LOWER LCL HEIGHTS...MAY ENHANCE THE THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND/HAIL THREAT WILL EXIST WITH CONVECTION OVER THE DAVIS MTNS AND AREAS DOWNSTREAM OVER PORTIONS OF BREWSTER/PECOS/TERRELL COUNTIES. A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED AS THE THREAT APPEARS TO BE RATHER LOCALIZED...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM INITIATION OVER THE DAVIS MTNS HAS OCCURRED WITHIN THE PAST 2 HRS WITHIN A HOT AND WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER. MODERATE NWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW /25-30 KTS/ ATOP SLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW HAS YIELDED EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES NEAR 40 KTS. WITH TIME...CONVECTION SHOULD BEGIN SPREADING TOWARDS THE SE WITH AN ATTENDANT DMGG WIND THREAT POSSIBLE GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF LARGE T-TD SPREADS /PER 22Z SFC OBS/ AND DEEPLY MIXED INVERTED-V SOUNDINGS. ADDITIONALLY...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE YIELDED MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG /DESPITE SFC DEW POINTS IN THE 50S/...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES AND SOME ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL. GIVEN THE EXPECTATION THAT THE GREATEST SVR POTENTIAL WILL REMAIN CONFINED TO A NARROW CORRIDOR DOWNSTREAM FROM ONGOING CONVECTION...COVERAGE APPEARS TO REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE ATTM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR DMGG WIND/HAIL NOW PRIMARILY CONFINED TO SRN SC...WHILE THE AIR MASS HAS STABILIZED OVER MOST OF FAR SERN GA WITH A SUBSEQUENT REDUCED SVR THREAT. WW CAN BE CLEARED BY WFO CHS FROM SW-NE IN WAKE OF CONVECTION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC OBS SHOW WINDS VEERING IN WAKE OF ENEWD MOVING CONVECTION ALONG PRE-FRONTAL WEAK SFC TROUGH. AIR MASS APPEARS TO HAVE STABILIZED OVER MOST OF FAR SERN GA AND INTO FAR SWRN SC...WITH PRIMARY THREAT NOW FOCUSED NE OF BEAUFORT/HAMPTON COUNTIES SC. POCKETS OF ENHANCED INSTABILITY /MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG PER RECENT OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS DATA/ WHERE TEMPERATURES HAVE REACHED THE LOWER 80S SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED DEVELOPMENT OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DMGG WIND/HAIL. THE THREAT COULD EXTEND TO THE N/E OF THE ONGOING WW AREA FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...BUT WITH THE ONSET OF DIURNAL COOLING...A GENERAL DOWNTREND IN TSTM INTENSITY IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR AS WATCH EXPIRATION TIME OF 01Z APPROACHES. THUS...AN ADDITIONAL WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED BEYOND THIS TIME. ..ROGERS.. 05/22/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORMS MAY SPREAD ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH 02-03Z. SEVERE THREAT MAY NOT BE NEGLIGIBLE...BUT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN MARGINAL OR ISOLATED ENOUGH THAT A WW PROBABLY WILL NOT BECOME NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FORCING IN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF A STRONG MID/UPPER JET NOSING ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES INTO THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS APPEARS TO BE THE PRIMARY FORCING FOR RECENT STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN MONTANA. THIS IS IN A POST-FRONTAL REGIME THAT IS NOT PARTICULARLY MOIST...OR UNSTABLE...AT LEAST IN TERMS OF CAPE ...BUT LOW TO MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES REMAIN STEEP. 40+ KT WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW IS STRONGLY SHEARED...HOWEVER...AND THIS COULD ENHANCE CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL...INCLUDING AT LEAST A LOW RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...WHILE ADVECTING ACTIVITY EASTWARD INTO THE WESTERN DAKOTAS THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE EVOLUTION OF A SEVERE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM STILL APPEARS POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS PARTS OF NORTHERN/CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT ISOLATED SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT APPEARS FOCUSED NEAR A SURFACE LOW CENTER WEST OF MINOT...WHERE AN EASTERLY COMPONENT TO THE NEAR SURFACE FLOW IS ENHANCING LOW-LEVEL SHEAR. AS THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF A MID/UPPER JET STREAK NOSING EAST NORTHEAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES CONTRIBUTES TO STRENGTHENING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ACROSS THE REGION THIS EVENING...THIS CELL PROBABLY WILL MERGE WITH AN APPROACHING CLUSTER OF STORMS EMERGING FROM NORTHEASTERN MONTANA/SOUTHERN SASKATCHEWAN. AND FURTHER UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH APPEARS LIKELY THROUGH 02-03Z...INCLUDING EVENTUAL SOUTH SOUTHEASTWARD DEVELOPMENT INTO THE WARM SECTOR OF THE SURFACE LOW ACROSS CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA. AS THIS OCCURS...IN THE PRESENCE OF A WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW FIELD STRENGTHENING TO 30-50 KT... IT STILL APPEARS THAT THE SEVERE THREAT MAY TRANSITION FROM MAINLY LARGE HAIL/ISOLATED TORNADOES INTO GENERALLY POTENTIALLY DAMAGING CONVECTIVE SURFACE GUSTS. ..KERR.. 05/22/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT WITHIN WW 289 IS NOW PRIMARILY CONFINED TO PORTIONS OF SRN GA...WHILE ADDITIONAL AREAS E OF WW 289 MAY SEE AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW IS NOT EXPECTED BEYOND SCHEDULED EXPIRATION TIME OF 01Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS CONTINUE ALONG/NEAR A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT...WHICH WAS POSITIONED 15 NE MAI TO 15 W VDI AS OF 23Z. STRONGEST TSTMS NOW APPEAR TO BE ALONG ERN PORTIONS OF WW 289 MOVING INTO PORTIONS OF SERN GA AND NRN FL. THREAT HERE IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 1-2 HRS WITHIN FOCUSED ZONE OF ASCENT ATTENDANT TO UPPER LOW OVER W-CNTRL GA. DIURNAL BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING SHOULD REDUCE POTENTIAL INSTABILITY SOMEWHAT...BUT MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE MUCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 1000-1500 J/KG WILL STILL EXIST THROUGH THE LATE EVENING. CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL OUTPUT ALSO SUPPORTS PERSISTENCE OF TSTMS THROUGH 03Z BEFORE MOVING OFFSHORE. REDUCTION IN INSTABILITY SHOULD LEAD TO A GENERAL DOWNTREND IN TSTM INTENSITY...BUT ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS/HAIL WILL STILL BE POSSIBLE. GIVEN EXPECTED ISOLATED AND SHORT-LIVED NATURE OF ANY SVR THREAT...A NEW WW IS NOT EXPECTED. ..ROGERS.. 05/23/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY...WITH FURTHER DEVELOPMENT STILL POSSIBLE THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ONGOING ALONG AND JUST EAST OF A NARROW PRE-FRONTAL CORRIDOR OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING ACROSS CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA. ACTIVITY HAS GENERALLY BEEN SLOWLY INTENSIFYING...BUT APPEARS TO BE STRUGGLING GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF STRONG MID-LEVEL INHIBITION STILL PRESENT...PARTICULARLY SOUTH OF THE NORTH DAKOTA/SOUTH DAKOTA BORDER AREA. STRONGER MID-LEVEL FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION APPEARS LIKELY TO REMAIN NORTH OF THE STATE BORDER THIS EVENING...BUT THE EASTWARD ADVECTION OF THE LEADING EDGE OF COOLER MID-LEVEL AIR COULD STILL WEAKEN INHIBITION ALONG/AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT ACROSS CENTRAL INTO EASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA LATER THIS EVENING. IF THIS OCCURS..IT WILL COINCIDE WITH PRE-FRONTAL SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET INTENSIFICATION IN EXCESS OF 40-50 KT...WHICH MAY CONTRIBUTE TO POTENTIAL FOR STRONG CONVECTIVE SURFACE GUSTS. ..KERR.. 05/23/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FOR REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF TORNADO WATCH 290 AND SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 291 CONTINUES. IT IS NOT CERTAIN THAT A NEW WW WILL BE NEEDED...BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A NEW WW EAST OF 290/291.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT INCREASE IN STORM DEVELOPMENT...SOUTHWEST OF JAMESTOWN ND INTO THE ABERDEEN SD AREA...APPEARS TO BE WHERE LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION IS BECOMING ENHANCED...NEAR THE NORTHERN EDGE OF MORE STRONGLY CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR...AS THE EXIT REGION OF A STRONG MID/UPPER JET STREAK CONTINUES TO NOSE EAST NORTHEAST OF THE NORTHERN ROCKIES THIS EVENING. THIS FORCING WILL GRADUALLY SPREAD EAST NORTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF NORTHWEST AND WEST CENTRAL MINNESOTA THROUGH 03-05Z. AS IT DOES...IT APPEARS THAT IT MAY BEGIN TO OUTRUN A WANING PRE-FRONTAL LOW-LEVEL INSTABILITY AXIS. POTENTIAL FOR SIGNIFICANT UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH IS BECOMING MORE UNCERTAIN...BUT IT DOES APPEAR POSSIBLE THAT AT LEAST SCATTERED VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT MAY BEGIN TO SPREAD TO THE EAST OF CURRENT WATCHES WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...ACCOMPANIED BY AT LEAST SOME RISK FOR HAIL/LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS.
